Full docs at docs.acme-saas.com

title: integrations
content:
# Integrations

## Slack

Connect Slack to receive real-time task notifications.

## GitHub

Link pull requests and issues to Acme tasks automatically.

## API

Use the REST API to build custom integrations.

title: [acme-saas] CSV export fails for large datasets
content:
Title: CSV export fails for large datasets
Body: When exporting more than 10,000 rows as CSV the download times out.
Resolution: Fixed in v2.3.1 — exports are now streamed server-side. Update to latest version.
